name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response relates to the context and maintains the topic of conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses how logically the response follows the preceding dialogue, ensuring a natural flow of conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the level of interest or enthusiasm displayed in the response, encouraging further dialogue.

name: Fact Integration
description: Checks how well the response incorporates any interesting facts or information provided in the context.

name: Clarity
description: Assesses the clarity of the response, ensuring it is easy to understand without ambiguity.

name: Empathy
description: Measures the degree of understanding and respect for the other person's feelings or opinions as expressed in the response.
